scripts.setup: npm install && npm run engine:sync && npm run data
scripts.data: cd engine && uv run replen-engine generate --out ../data/synthetic && uv run replen-engine import --dir ../data/synthetic --db ../.data/analytics.duckdb
scripts.contracts:generate: cd engine && uv run replen-engine export-schemas --out ../contracts/engine && cd .. && npm run generate -w @replen/contracts
scripts.lint:engine: cd engine && uv run ruff check src tests
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.benchmark: cd engine && uv run replen-engine benchmark --series 5000
